records.text: On the same canonical Fock, the closed Tomita graph of the concrete Weyl algebra and vacuum equals the exponential Tomita graph. Domains and actions agree. Independent recompilation and the real graph-closure proof were reviewed by separate hands. The concrete one-particle antiunitary maps KWR exactly onto its symplectic complement; proved using the genuine domain of the self-adjoint half-modular multiplier. The actual dual weight on the same Fock regular core is additive, homogeneous, monotone and dual-invariant; its value at the unit is infinite. It is not the scaled trace. Nine core/embedding/action fields are supplied by terms, with 26 remaining fields explicit and no full inhabitant asserted. Whole main has started but is not yet certified complete.
